title: Restore reusable append-only governance recovery and ECR controls

triggerEvidence.summary: The adopted ECR lane cannot represent or append a subsequent W1.A03 authority record.
reproduction: Inspect planning/enabler-change-requests/enabler-change-request.schema.json: authorizedTaskIds is constant W1.A02.T01/T02 and taskInventory accepts only W1.A02.T01/T02.
Inspect taskctl amendment bootstrap-submit: the one-time bootstrap rejects an existing control plane and no command appends a new approved amendment definition.
A hypothetical ECR-0002/W1.A03 packet fails the canonical ECR schema before packet review or approval can be recorded.
triggerEvidence.requiredRecovery: Install generic versioned GRR/ECR schemas and an append-only authority operation that preserves and revalidates every predecessor.

triggerEvidence.summary: The human-decision Wave pause is not fail-closed in executable start/resume scheduling paths.
reproduction: At paused clean state 761dff4, taskctl next advertises a Wave start command instead of a stopped recovery handoff.
approved_unbootstrapped_amendment returns none and blocking_wave_amendments is empty because ECR-0002 cannot be represented.
command_wave_resume does not deny the human-decision pause category or the recorded recovery reason.
triggerEvidence.requiredRecovery: Add a generic immutable hold recognized by every Wave, task, amendment, scheduler, gate, and legacy-reader transition before any recovery or ECR execution.

triggerEvidence.summary: The cumulative UI gate contradicts its accepted additive pre-UI quality-inventory rule.
reproduction: additive_preimplementation_quality_scope_errors returns an empty error list for exact commit 461faf2870786609dea5a8e5214df380843329bb.
Validating bfb8797398707bece9e0662c0d995fabaced9979 through 59079efccc122a7d56a9f18efc20030851bf32a9 fails solely because no unrelated late protected hardening commit exists.
The regression introduced at 53376b7e0c038f013a7bf597d5ed9a7d8633fcf5 exercises the helper but not the cumulative foundation-then-UI range.
triggerEvidence.requiredRecovery: After the recovery kernel is approved, route the UI-gate correction and exact T03 lineage recovery through separately approved ECR-0002/W1.A03.

commandsDenied: ordinary Wave task claim, reopen, evidence attachment, submission, or review transition
unapproved amendment bootstrap, materialization, activation, disposition, or adoption
release-gate approval or local-main integration represented as approval
direct UI-gate or product-code change outside a later approved ECR
releaseConditions: GRR-0001 is independently reviewed and explicitly approved at one immutable commit.
GRR-0001.B00 is implemented within its exact path/outcome boundary and independently approved.
The repaired controller appends and validates ECR-0002/W1.A03 without rewriting W1.A01 or W1.A02.
W1.A03 is separately approved, completed, independently exit-reviewed, and adopted with a control/security checkpoint.
An explicit ordinary W1 resume and controlled T03 recovery occur after adoption.

bootstrapUnit.exceptionReason: The adopted ECR validator and controller cannot represent the subsequent amendment required to repair themselves, while their resume boundary is not fail-closed.
requiredOutcomes: A minimal recovery controller validates generic versioned GRR packets, exact independent review, explicit human approval, bounded bootstrap evidence, append-only remediation, and terminal disposition.
A controller-enforced hold denies all executable Wave/task/amendment/gate and older-reader paths until exact release conditions are satisfied.
ECR validation supports generic subsequent identities and an ordered predecessor authority chain without changing ECR-0001, W1.A01, W1.A02, or their Git objects.
A compare-and-swap append operation can add a subsequent approved amendment but cannot replace, reorder, duplicate, fork, or silently migrate an existing record.
Status and review pages provide a decision-complete stopped-recovery handoff with packet, authority, alternatives, and exact next approval or resume condition.

Focused tests prove second and third GRR/ECR/amendment identities, cross-field identity binding, stale and dirty denial, self-review denial, predecessor preservation, older-reader denial, and atomic failure behavior.
B00 receives an independent control/security disposition before ECR-0002 is prepared or appended.
prohibitedOutcomes: No product/runtime, UI implementation, UI reference, or tools/ui_change_gate.py change.
No change to task acceptance criteria, verification thresholds, canonical full profiles, completed evidence/reviews, W1 approval, or release-gate state.
No rewrite, deletion, or replacement of W1 base authority, W1.A01, W1.A02, their approvals, reviews, adoption evidence, or prior Git objects.
No ordinary Wave task claim, T03 reopen/submission, W1 resume, G1 approval, local-main integration, or remote push.
No force, override, bypass, skip-review, or unbounded emergency execution option.

acceptanceCriteria: The exact W1 base plus ordered W1.A01/W1.A02 authority, hashes, commits, task outcomes, and adoption history remain unchanged.
Generic recovery and ECR schemas accept subsequent well-bound identities and reject mismatched Wave, amendment, bootstrap, task, file, review, and predecessor identities.
Unresolved recovery/ECR holds fail closed across scheduler, start, resume, claim, reopen, evidence, submit, review, amendment, gate, generated handoff, and older-reader paths.
Dirty, stale, duplicate, forked, reordered, wrong-hash, missing-review, and self-approved packets fail atomically without ledger or file mutation.
Second and third GRR/ECR/amendment fixtures append successfully without replacing or rewriting predecessor authority.
Bootstrap review and remediation history is append-only and exact-commit bound, and no product or ordinary W1 execution occurs.
The repaired ordinary lane can freeze ECR-0002/W1.A03 but cannot approve, materialize, activate, adopt, or resume it without its separate required reviews and human approval.
verificationObligations: Validate this packet against its exact generic Draft 2020-12 schema and verify every listed file SHA-256.
Verify every authority commit exists on the current branch, every approval/evidence blob matches its recorded hash and introduction commit, and ordered A01/A02 state is unchanged.
Run focused recovery, planctl, taskctl, backlog schema, generated-view, review-page, and quality tests including hostile second/third identity fixtures.
Independently review GRR-0001 at its exact clean packet commit before human approval and independently review B00 before ordinary ECR use.
Defer the UI-gate cumulative pass/adversarial suite, T03 product qualification, complete W1 matrix, local-main integration, and G1 review to their separately authorized gates.
rollback: Before exact human approval, reject or defer GRR-0001 while retaining its immutable proposal; W1 and T03 remain paused/blocked.
During B00, any failed validation or review preserves the hold and requires append-only remediation with a strict-descendant candidate and fresh independent disposition.
After approved B00 but before ECR-0002 approval, withdraw or defer the ordinary ECR without releasing the hold or resuming W1.
Never roll back by deleting a GRR, approval, finding, amendment, evidence record, checkpoint, or Git object.
nonGoals: No alternate product-delivery lane or general-purpose emergency override.
No UI-gate correction, T03 code change, T03 approval, W1 qualification, G1 approval, local-main merge, or remote push.
No weakening of independent review, human approval, evidence binding, security/privacy review, or complete Wave-exit qualification.
No cloud, external service, credential, hardware, deployment, benchmark, or researcher-data change.
